QUOTE: It installs its own calloc/free through `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free`. With `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` it uses mutex-wrapped variants.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says that the init function installs mutex-wrapped calloc/free variants when `MBEDTLS_THREADING_C` is on. It implies plain ones otherwise, but it doesn't say the choice is made at compile time.
